title: Boba Fett
description: A pure genetic replication of the mercenary Jango Fett, Boba Fett witnessed his father's murder at the hands of Mace Windu at a young age and had to make his own way in the galaxy. He became a notorious bounty hunter and, after making his way out of the Sarlacc pit, set his sights on becoming the Daimyo of Mos Espa in Jabba's old territory.
